items.title: 52043_Herman Autrey oral history interview
items.q: And he was there, in Hamburg, with my daughter, and two children. And we had a ball.

ctx.x: Oh yes, she's -- she's married to -- has two children, Tony and Angela, around ten, ten or eleven, and her husband's a colonel in the Army. He's in over -- in Saiwon, Saigon, or somewhere over there. He's -- he left here as a major and now he's a colonel.
